[EN] This labyrinth is filled with insane clowns who would pull their own arms off if it meant pleasing Killian.

Killian's jesters came into this world for one purpose—to entertain Killian.

I charge you with this duty—eliminate all the jesters in the labyrinth.
[ES] Este laberinto está lleno de payasos dementes que se arrancarían los brazos con tal de complacer a Killian.

Los bufones de Killian llegaron a este mundo con un solo propósito: entretener a Killian.

Te encomiendo esta tarea: elimina a todos los bufones del laberinto.

[EN] Excellent! That petulant child deserves to have some of his toys broken.

On a practical level, if Killian is bored, he'll be more likely to make mistakes.
[ES] ¡Excelente! Ese niño petulante merece que le rompan algunos de sus juguetes.

A nivel práctico, si Killian está aburrido, será más propenso a cometer errores.
